*.reason: Webpack adds a script element for each chunk it loads and removes it once loaded, so whether a recording catches one depends on timing. Build file names, never a visitor's value (a route group such as app/(home) keeps its parentheses in the path).

rrweb keeps the box size and position of a left-out element (tool results, charts) so the replay keeps its layout. They change with how much a panel shows, such as more rows or a longer note, never with the text or values inside it.
The scroll position of a scrolling element when the snapshot was taken: timing, not input.
React's generated element ids (useId) count components in render order, so they shift when a panel shows or not. Generated, never a visitor's value.
Whether a typed value was accepted: a field's aria-invalid state and its hint's error class. The value and the hint's text stay masked.

analysis.reason: With one set's filters the explorer widens its group or has too few finishes, so it shows its one-line note (or its 'not enough results' state and Try again button) where the other set shows neither. Which line shows, not the filters or the numbers (the text in .analysis-layout is masked).

The result chart's scrubber state (WP3): whether the pointer, wiggled over the page, crossed the chart and moved its needle off the opening position, lit a detent or flipped the drag hint. Where the pointer was, never a typed value; the readout text stays masked.
